supported_source_facts.fact: Development Settings observer is registered in fragment onStart and unregistered in onStop. A process/package/dependency row alone does not establish that active fragment.

Fixed -p option sets the exact package and dumpClient=true; dump display defaults to INVALID_DISPLAY. Literal activities routes to ATMS dump with dumpAll=true. No -v/-f/-d/--user restriction is requested.

ATMS routes the command while holding mGlobalLock, prints the exact header, invokes RootWindowContainer.dumpActivities, and separately prints the matching top-resumed Activity. General supervisor/process/UID/starting-process summaries are omitted under the package filter.

Outer activities dump iterates connected displays, root tasks and focused Activities; it also iterates global finishing and stopping lists. With the default INVALID_DISPLAY filter, no display is intentionally excluded.
printThisActivity and ActivityRecord.dumpActivity use exact packageName equality; dumpActivity prints matching rows without a Activity-state predicate before optional client output.

dumpHistoryList never updates its printed=false local, even when matching records print. Therefore the terminal (nothing) can coexist with stop/finish rows. Header can be cleared after an earlier filtered record; reject extra rows even without a list header.

Recent-task package predicates use task intent/affinity/original/real/caller or exposed base/top fields; these are not all nested Activity records. The existing summary readers are not completeness proof.

Task extends TaskFragment, and the actual root-task dump overload delegates to an inherited dump method. Separate getDumpActivitiesLocked("all") traversal is not used by the reviewed activities dump and cannot substitute for its proof.
